rationale: The assistant correctly identified the likely causes (dial at max, food against vents) and gave safe, sensible steps with no part recommended. It was overconfident ('explains it perfectly'), with a somewhat questionable claim that max makes the compressor run continuously. It also did not suggest a fridge thermometer or say when to call an engineer if freezing persists, though it did invite a follow-up if things stay frozen after 24 hours.
